responsibility: Declares the exported `function_base` objects for the RVV intrinsic subsystem. It provides the `bases::` namespace interface used by the vector builtin tables to name the semantic expansion class associated with each intrinsic family, without defining naming rules, type iteration, or expansion code itself.
same_name_distinction: Within the `riscv-vector-builtins-bases` pair, this header only publishes the `bases::` namespace of `function_base` object declarations used by the rest of the RVV builtin framework. Unlike `riscv-vector-builtins-bases.cc`, it does not define any expansion classes, semantic behavior, or object instances.
